name: Trace Border Interactive Button
composition: Solid dark button with a glowing 1.5px border highlight tracing around the outer perimeter.
focal_point: Bright accent light beam moving along the SVG border path.
layout_behavior: Inline-block action button with relative positioning and overflow-visible container.
typography_characteristics: 14px semibold sans-serif with tight tracking and centered icon.
choreography: Border stroke traces continuously on loop or triggers 1 full rotation on hover (400ms).
perceived_physics: Precise laser-like energy loop around high-craft UI boundary.
interaction_model: Hover accelerates trace speed; active press applies scale(0.97).
visual_hierarchy: Primary call-to-action button designed to stand out against neutral dark card.
why_it_works: Perimeter motion draws peripheral visual focus directly to the main action without heavy fills.
accessibility: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Ensure focus ring remains visible outside SVG trace.
performance: SVG stroke-dasharray animation is lightweight on GPU.
web_implementation_strategy: Pure CSS keyframe animation on `stroke-dashoffset` or Tailwind arbitrary SVG class.
portfolio_applications: Hero section 'View Live App' or 'Explore Case Study' primary CTA button.
notes: Extracted from Jitter 'The Click' template collection.

name: Liquid Glass Toggle Switch
composition: Pill-shaped toggle track holding an inner sliding circle knob.
focal_point: Inner circle expanding slightly into an ellipse while sliding.
layout_behavior: Inline flex container with fixed width (48px) and height (28px).
choreography: Knob stretches (`scaleX(1.15)`) and slides across track (150ms). Track color fades to accent hue.
perceived_physics: Tactile, rubbery liquid feel like physical hardware switch.
interaction_model: Click or keyboard Space/Enter toggles boolean state.
visual_hierarchy: ON state displays high contrast accent background; OFF state remains muted neutral.
why_it_works: Mid-travel stretching mimics physical inertia, creating delightful tactile feedback.
avoid_when: Complex multi-option selection (use radio group or segment control instead)
web_implementation_strategy: Framer Motion layout switch or Tailwind group-checked transition.
portfolio_applications: Interactive project showcase mode toggle (e.g. 'Desktop View / Mobile View').
notes: Observed from Jitter interactive toggle templates.
